obligations.expected_behavior: Read an explicit current snapshot before producing a Quick Dev recommendation.
forbidden_result: The recommendation is based on an implicit, stale, or unspecified snapshot.
obligations.observable_result: The recommendation process records or demonstrably uses the explicit current snapshot.
obligations.state_after: An explicit current snapshot has been read and is the basis for the recommendation.
obligations.state_before: No explicit current snapshot has yet been read for the recommendation.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev recommendation-only mode
obligations.trigger: When generating a Quick Dev recommendation

obligations.expected_behavior: Distinguish observations that remain reusable from observations that have been invalidated.
forbidden_result: Reusable and invalidated observations are merged without distinction.
An invalidated observation is treated as reusable.
obligations.observable_result: Each considered observation is classified as reusable or invalidated in the recommendation processing.
obligations.state_after: Observations are explicitly separated into reusable and invalidated categories.
obligations.state_before: Observations have not yet been distinguished by validity for reuse.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev recommendation-only mode
obligations.trigger: When evaluating observations for a recommendation

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not run tests while operating in recommendation-only mode.
forbidden_result: Any test command or test execution is started.
obligations.observable_result: No tests are run and no new test execution results are produced.
obligations.state_before: The recommendation operation is active and could otherwise invoke tests.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev recommendation-only mode

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not create a run while operating in recommendation-only mode.
forbidden_result: A new run record or run lifecycle is created.
obligations.observable_result: No run is created by the recommendation operation.
obligations.state_after: No new run exists as a result of the recommendation.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev recommendation-only mode

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not call a model while operating in recommendation-only mode.
forbidden_result: A model or LLM invocation is made.
obligations.state_after: No model call has occurred during recommendation generation.
obligations.state_before: The recommendation operation is active and could otherwise invoke a model.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev recommendation-only mode

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not write lifecycle state while operating in recommendation-only mode.
forbidden_result: Lifecycle state is created, updated, or otherwise written.
obligations.observable_result: Lifecycle state is unchanged after the recommendation operation.
obligations.state_after: All lifecycle state remains unchanged by the recommendation.
obligations.state_before: Existing lifecycle state, if any, is present and must not be modified.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev recommendation-only mode
